regions.merged_text: Only now I come to your letter of Dec. 190 - after Il p.m. God help us! I hardly know how the time slips by. Your cousin Mildred called from Chicago a week or so back and I had a little word with several of them including Captain Florence Casey was just then being transerred to Detroit Mich. Thanks be to God they all seem to be well - including even your Aunt - "Grandma Grace". In fact Grace gave me a pleasant surprise - a "congratu- lations ... " on my 83rd birthday. Your Uncles Pat and Owen also wrote and Mgr. Edw'd. All well Dec Gr .!

regions.merged_text: Blessed be the Most Holy Trinity in every tick of time ! God bless you Eileen again - two months after this was supposed to be yours. Looking for something quite dif- fierent late last night I felt ashamed of myself to find these cards still "just snowed under" (all kinds of let- ters, etc) Please God I'll get it off today. I hope you are keeping well these days - at once so restless, so foreboding in in the materialistic world; yet by the grace and mercy of God, so colorful and so promising!
